Hi Marius,

Thank you for writing, and I'm sorry the wait has asked this much of you.

Here is where your order stands. Shop···· is paid and nothing has shipped, and I have put a hold on it at our warehouse so nothing moves while we sort this out. Your Harlo B30 ships November 14, which is about two and a half weeks away. It isn't stock sitting on a shelf: your unit is being manufactured and allocated to you, with the redesigned, quieter cooling we wrote to you about on September 15, and what you paid went into building that specific unit. You can follow the batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Before we cancel anything, two options that keep every dollar you paid with you. The first is store credit for the full amount you paid, on your account, usable straight away on anything we have in stock. The second is a swap to a unit that ships now from our EU warehouse: the Hammer BC04 (6 TH/s, $249) or the Hammer Thor P2 (10 TH/s, $379), both in stock and shipping within 2 business days, with the difference coming back to you as store credit. Both are smaller machines than the B30, so I'd only suggest them if having something running this week matters more to you than the hashrate.

Just reply here and tell me which you'd prefer, or that you'd still rather not keep the order, and I'll take it from there the same day.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Marius,

I'm sorry you had to chase this, and sorry for the silence since your last email. That's on us.

Where things stand right now: Shop···· is paid, nothing has shipped, and I have the order held on both our side and the warehouse, so no box can go out while this is being settled. Your B30 itself is dated to ship November 14.

Your cancellation and refund request is now with a supervisor for review. They start at 10am Eastern today and it is in front of them, so you do not need to do anything or wait in this thread. You will get the decision and the confirmation by email as soon as it is made. I'm not going to put a figure or a date on it myself, because the refund is theirs to approve, not mine, and I would rather tell you nothing than tell you something that turns out to be wrong.

Two things I can do for you today, if either appeals more than waiting on that. I can cancel the order and put the full amount you paid on your account as store credit, available immediately and usable on anything we have in stock, which is faster than any card refund. Or I can swap the B30 for a unit that ships now from our EU warehouse, the Hammer BC04 at $249 or the Hammer Thor P2 at $379, both in stock and leaving within two business days, with the difference coming back to you as store credit. Both are smaller machines than the B30, so that only makes sense if having something mining this week matters more to you than the hashrate.

If you'd rather simply hold for the supervisor's answer, that's completely fine and nothing is needed from you.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thanks for checking in, and I'm sorry you're still waiting. There is no decision recorded on your order yet, so I won't pretend otherwise.

One thing that remains entirely in my hands, if you'd rather not wait on anyone: I can cancel the order today and put the full amount you paid on your account as store credit, usable straight away on anything we have in stock. That is credit on your account rather than money back to your card, so it is only worth taking if you'd still buy from us. If that's not what you want, just ignore it and sit tight for the supervisor.

Hi Marius,

Thanks for flagging it, and I'm sorry, you're right to chase.

I've looked at the payment record directly. Your order is cancelled, and the refund of $970.97 was raised against your Solana Pay payment on 3 November. It is still showing as pending on the processor's side, which means it has not settled yet, and that is why nothing has landed with you. I don't have a transaction hash to give you, because one only exists once the transfer is actually broadcast, and I'm not going to invent one.

I've put this in front of the team this morning with everything they need: the order, the amount, and the fact that the refund is stuck pending rather than sent. They're on from 10am Eastern today, and getting that transfer broadcast and the hash back to you is the one thing on it. The reply comes to you in this thread.

Your money is not at risk and the order is cancelled, so nothing is shipping and nothing is owed by you. I'm sorry this has taken as long as it has.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
